diagnosis: The account is on 'startup' plan with 'basic' support tier. Per kb-0010, audit log access requires standard or premium support tier. The 403 is expected behavior for an unentitled feature call.
reply:
Thanks for reaching out. I've looked into the 403 you're receiving from the audit endpoint. This isn't a permissions configuration issue on your side—it's related to your current plan and support tier. The audit log feature requires a standard or premium support tier, which isn't included with your current startup plan with basic support.

To gain access to the audit endpoint, you would need to upgrade to a plan that includes standard or premium support. If you'd like to explore upgrade options, I can connect you with our team who can walk you through what's available and any differences in features and pricing.

If you have other questions, feel free to ask.
